results.title: Deep multiples of the generator
results.caption: Lemma
results.summary: For every prime element $\pi$ of $\mathbb Z[s]$ and every integer $N\ge1$ there is an integer $m\ge1$ with $[m]P_0\in E_N(\pi)$; then $[jm]P_0\in E_N(\pi)$ for every $j\in\mathbb Z$. Consequently, for every finite set $\Pi$ of prime elements and every $N\ge1$ there is $\kappa\ge1$ with $[j\kappa]P_0\in E_N(\pi)$ for all $\pi\in\Pi$ and $j\in\mathbb Z$.
